projectSummary: Supports the existence of a separately innervated abdominal part with its own entry pattern.

publication.statusSource: Crossref REST API works record plus the Crossref/Retraction Watch CSV export, both fetched 2026-09-13

notes: Abstract-only; the innervation sentence is truncated in the retrievable abstract.

study.intervention: Cadaveric dissection of neurovascular entry into the abdominal head.
study.population: Thirty-two hemithoraxes were dissected and the distribution patterns of neurovascular structures within the abdominal head of the pectoralis major were classified; entry points were measured against a horizontal line through the jugular notch and the midclavicular line.

title: Neurovascular distribution within the abdominal head of the pectoralis major muscle: Application to breast and flap surgery.
